alerts.title: Abdominal pain on TLD: screen for ADR and non-drug causes
alerts.message: Guidelines require all HWs to screen each encounter for suspected ADRs using the Drug Safety Screening checklist, and to record and report any suspected ADR, mild or severe. Patient P004 (TDF, 3TC, DTG since March 2023, no other medications) presents with abdominal pain without fever and with preserved appetite. Dolutegravir-associated adverse effects in the excerpts include neuropsychiatric symptoms, hyperglycaemia and abnormal weight gain, but none of these are reported, and abdominal pain is not specifically linked to TLD in the excerpts. Non-drug causes such as GI infection or other abdominal pathology cannot be excluded from the record. Creatinine (82 umol/L) and viral load (25 copies/mL) were last measured 78 days before the visit, and no examination detail beyond appetite and absence of fever is documented.

evidence.recommended_action: Complete the Drug Safety Screening checklist for this encounter, including the full symptom review (neuropsychiatric, hyperglycaemia, weight change). Document abdominal examination findings, and record and report any suspected ADR via HMIS.
